reviews.text: William helped our puppy Delilah with a  5 week training course. He is an amazing trainer who uses a calm, positive approach to train . Our puppy loved him. I would highly recommend him!!

I’m a two decade dog rescuer who has mainly focused on beagles. I impulsively adopted a dog from a shelter because he looked like a senior beagle online. Turns out he was a 60lb, 9 month old shepherd mix! I was already in love, and he was coming home with me no matter what.

I reached out to DOGMAN within the first week of having him because I could tell I would need help learning to interact with this new breed. William was wonderful. I really appreciate his bottom-up approach to training versus a top-down, here are some commands style. Elmore responded well to all his sessions, and maybe more importantly, so did I! Teaching Elmore boundaries and impulse control has been a game changer. He’s able to regulate himself now. Training with William helped Elmore and I establish a trusting relationship. He’s my best friend. I highly recommend William and will continue to seek his services.

We have a dog who was a pandemic puppy that was not responding to our training. After working with 3 different trainers, we were beginning to think that we might never get her to learn appropriate behavior around other dogs. After attending a presentation by William of Dogman,  we decided to ask him to work with us. His approach is very different as he has a unique perspective of a dog's psyche. During the very first session, our dog's behavior and demeanor was altering in real time. We have completed the lessons and I am happy to report that we can now go on enjoyable walks with our fur baby. William truly understands dogs. Working with him has been a pleasure and a blessing for our family.

We are incredibly grateful for Dogman and the care they provide for our 14-year-old Labrador with special needs.

The team shows exceptional attention to detail, thoughtfully adapting her feeding routine, managing medications, and adjusting to her changing needs with skill and compassion. Her age and needs have never been treated as a deterrent for daycare or boarding — instead, she receives calm, confident care with attentive staff present day and night.

We are in a tender stage with her, and knowing she is safe, comfortable, and well cared for gives us great peace of mind. We trust Dogman completely and are thankful for the compassionate care they provide.

I called Dogman (William)  because my 3 1/2 year old Great Pyrenees mix was nipping and growling at family members and  very reactive to other dogs on walks.  Dogman (William) was extremely brave, patient and willing to deal directly with my 95 pound dog.  With Dogman's training, (he mostly trained us because we were the ones that needed it most),  my dog, Krypto, has become  much better  behaved and friendly, and we now understand how he thinks and how to maintain this new and improved behaviour. This has been a wonderful experience,  thoroughly successful, and extremely helpful.  What we learned from William will last a lifetime.

Thanks,  William!!!

Sharon Slopis, Michael Gadbois, and my brother, John Slopis

I brought my 4 month old puppy Onyx to Dogman Training, and even though she's still learning because she is young, she did learn to sit and respond to her name — which is a great start. Dogman is a one-man show, and it’s clear he really cares about the dogs he works with. He’s patient, professional, and brings calm energy that animals connect with. I appreciate his time and dedication. Definitely someone to consider if you’re looking for a trainer  with heart and experience. I look forward to our 2 week follow up. Thank you again William aka Dogman 🐶💕🐾

We have used DOGMAN for boarding (a week+ at a time) and it’s always been a great experience. We love William and his team—what’s more important is that our dog loves them and always seems happy to go there. I like their approach of making it feel like a home; and appreciate the occasional photo or video update! Highly recommend.
Our pup had a great experience boarding at Dogman, and William was so kind to help us get her in on a busy weekend when previous plans fell through! Highly recommend!

My old dog is learning new tricks! I was in need of finding a new daycare and boarding situation for my very highly anxious 8 yo dachshund-mix. I turned to Dogman Training both from driving by and word-of-mouth. William was wonderful! He evaluated Summer in-home first and we began a series of training classes immediately. I am learning to be a better pet-parent to her and she is showing that she is up to learning new commands and structure! She is so happy and excited for daycare and had a great first boarding experience there. Happily and highly recommend!!!

William is outstanding with all types of dogs.  I have one wild woman and one laid back old man and they have both made such progress with William. I would recommend him to anyone wanting good manners in their dogs - he absolutely knows how to kindly train them and bring out their best behavior.  He has privately trained my 2 year old wild woman and she is so sweet now - still a little free spirit but she’s only two years old and with William’s help will continue to calm down. She LOVES William and can’t wait to see him when we go to day care. And when I left town this summer, both dogs boarded with William and I knew they would be so well taken care of it made my trip worry free.  I highly recommend William to anyone wanting to bring out the best in their babies.
